issue:
Temp tables not parsed correctly using tsql dialect when using quoted identifiers

https://github.com/tobymao/sqlglot/issues/3399 - describes how quoted temp tables work with Microsoft tsql.

To use a Microsoft SQL Server temporary table with a name that requires quoting (such as when it contains spaces or reserved characters), you must place the # symbol inside the square brackets: [#Table Name]

The SQL below when parsed has no temporary attribute.

```
>>> exp = sg.parse_one("select name from [#temp_table]", dialect="tsql")
>>> exp
Select(
  expressions=[
    Column(
      this=Identifier(this=name, quoted=False))],
  from_=From(
    this=Table(
      this=Identifier(this='#temp_table', quoted=True))))
```
sqlglot will set a temporary attribute when the # character shows up outside the quoted brackets, but this is invalid tsql.

```
>>> exp = sg.parse_one("select name from #[temp_table]", dialect="tsql")
>>> exp
Select(
  expressions=[
    Column(
      this=Identifier(this=name, quoted=False))],
  from_=From(
    this=Table(
      this=Identifier(this='temp_table', quoted=True, temporary=True))))
```

Using the example from: https://github.com/tobymao/sqlglot/issues/3399

You can't round trip from duckdb to tsql and back to duckdb.

```
>>> exp = sg.parse_one("CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE 'temptest' (name VARCHAR);", dialect="duckdb")

>>> exp
Create(
  this=Schema(
    this=Table(
      this=Identifier(this='temptest', quoted=True)),
    expressions=[
      ColumnDef(
        this=Identifier(this=name, quoted=False),
        kind=DataType(this=Type.TEXT, nested=False))]),
  kind=TABLE,
  properties=Properties(
    expressions=[
      TemporaryProperty()]))

>>> exp.sql(dialect="tsql")
'CREATE TABLE [#temptest] (name VARCHAR(MAX))'

>>> ## No temporary attribute below..
>>> exp = sg.parse_one("CREATE TABLE [#temptest] (name VARCHAR(MAX))", dialect="tsql")

>>> exp
Create(
  this=Schema(
    this=Table(
      this=Identifier(this='#temptest', quoted=True)),
    expressions=[
      ColumnDef(
        this=Identifier(this=name, quoted=False),
        kind=DataType(
          this=Type.VARCHAR,
          expressions=[
            DataTypeParam(
              this=Var(this=MAX))],
          nested=False))]),
  kind=TABLE)

>>> exp.sql(dialect="duckdb")
'CREATE TABLE "#temptest" (name TEXT(MAX))'
```
